items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Well I used to play out there with them.

ctx.x: May's Sugar Factory out here in Commercial Avenue? No, I didn't know about it.

Well there was, he was born and raised in Yarns, May's was. And he, after he got out there, he formed the union and he got the boys from Local 208 out there, see. And he formed a band out there. Well I used to play out there with them. I was going to work out there with them. But in later years, he made so much money, he built a home right out there, see. And he gave up the working, see, and he's sitting down now. But at the same time, why? I don't know, it just, afterwards it's just one of those things. I'm here…
Soon as I moved in here, she got sick.
